summary: Mooney M20C (N6466U) with pilot Howard Guthrie, 55, and passenger Melissa Watson, 42, both of Albuquerque, crashed in poor weather near Stevens Field after turning around en route from Moriarty NM to Pagosa Springs; both aboard killed. Archuleta County SAR launched a search Nov 17 on a USAF alert; a multi-agency air/ground search (Upper San Juan, La Plata and Mineral County SAR teams, Southern Ute rangers, CAP, USAF C-130) found the wreckage Nov 19 in southern Archuleta County. NTSB CEN15FA051.
location: Stevens Field area, Pagosa Springs (southern Archuleta County, San Juan National Forest)
responding_agency: Archuleta County SAR (Upper San Juan SAR); La Plata County SAR; Mineral County SAR; Southern Ute rangers; Civil Air Patrol; USAF
notes: Date = NTSB accident date (Friday ~17:30 MST, 1/2-mi visibility in light snow, 100-ft ceiling, no IFR flight plan). USAF contacted ACSO Emergency Management 7:23 PM Mon Nov 17 (alert notice 11/17); 3 Archuleta SAR ground teams + 3 aircraft + military helo searched Tue Nov 18; USAF C-130 FLIR flight Mon night unsuccessful; Wed Nov 19 Upper San Juan SAR met La Plata/Mineral SAR + Southern Ute rangers, ~10 ground teams deployed east of Tuesday's area; wreckage found 12:37 PM Wed by ground crews, tail number matched, both occupants deceased.
